hero.heading: A website, a model service, and a site written as data
hero.lead: Four pages are served by one small Express server. The part that looks at photos is a separate Python service that the server starts and supervises, so the site keeps working when Python does not. This page is generated from the tree: the files, line counts, routes, tests and variables below were read from the project when it was built.
